change.title: Content update: rule 0291 for template T4

verdict.headline: Remove f13 from rule-0291 criteria to fix content-interpreter exit_code=3 failure
verdict.cause: The change adds rule-0291 for template T4 with criteria f01 and f13. Contract ic-0006 specifies inputs_supplied=12 for content-interpreter.load_rules. Candidate experiment (x-0a62a89848144148) shows exit_code=3 with fatal error: "rule rule-0291 read an input slot that does not exist (12 inputs supplied)". The rule references f13 which maps to the 13th input slot, but only 12 slots are supplied (f01-f12). The fix is to remove f13 from rule-0291's criteria. Baseline experiment (x-f4b9e164c6374d16) with 3 rules having 2-3 fields each and exit_code=0 confirms the interpreter works when rules stay within 12 input slots.
tested: x-f4b9e164c6374d16: baseline · workload default → all assertions passed
x-0a62a89848144148: candidate · workload default → failed: interpreter_keeps_running
x-484f92bf9b1943ff: candidate · workload default → failed: interpreter_keeps_running
x-de826d8d819c42b5: control · workload default → all assertions passed
limitations: The investigator predicted the change was safe, but the experiments reproduced a failure; its explanation is not reliable.

- No test of rule-0291 with f13 removed in the candidate experiment
- Only default workload tested; other workloads may have different input expectations
- Full template T4 field mapping not retrieved (f01-f13 assumed but not confirmed)

mitigation.text: Remove the "f13" entry from rule-0291.json's criteria field, keeping only "f01". The corrected rule should be: {"criteria": {"f01": "m-0291-f01"}, "rule_id": "rule-0291", "template": "T4"}. This ensures the rule only references fields within the 12 input slots the interpreter supplies, preventing the exit_code=3 failure.

hypotheses.claim: Rule-0291 for template T4 causes content-interpreter exit_code=3 failure because the rule specifies f13 in its criteria, but template T4 has inputs_supplied=12 (contract ic-0006). The error "read an input slot that does not exist" occurs because f13 references the 13th input slot which is not among the 12 supplied. The fix is to remove f13 from rule-0291's criteria, since the interpreter only processes 12 input slots (f01-f12). Existing rules for T4 (rule-0280, 0281, 0282) have only 2-3 fields and work fine, confirming the interpreter does not require all 13 template fields to be specified.
hypotheses.mechanism: The rule-0291 criteria include f13, but contract ic-0006 specifies inputs_supplied=12 for content-interpreter.load_rules. When the interpreter evaluates rule-0291, it tries to access input slot 13 (for f13) but only 12 slots are supplied, causing exit_code=3 failure.
